subject: Finteq evaluation — stakeholder map, procurement path, and security kickoff
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@finteq.com>, Jacob Myers <j.myers@finteq.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:12:00 +0100
Subject: Post-discovery: Finteq stakeholder map, procurement path, and security kickoff

Hi Elena & Jacob,

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciated the clarity on your current stack and the pilot goals. Short recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned:  

Summary from our discovery
- Primary use case: customer support summarization and internal knowledge search for a subset of EU customers (PII-scrubbed flows).
- Systems in scope (prelim): customer support DB (Postgres), S3 buckets for archived transcripts, and the staging inference cluster in GCP eu-west1.
- Initial pilot constraint: no customer PII stored in model context; auditability required for tokens and prompts.

Stakeholder map (as discussed) — please confirm:  
- Security/Compliance: Elena Rossi (security@finteq.com) — technical owner for scope and evidence
- Infra/Platform: Jacob Myers (j.myers@finteq.com) — network diagrams, VPC peering, IP allowlists
- Procurement: Sophie Park (procurement) — commercial/PO cadence (you mentioned Sophie on the call)
- Economic buyer: CFO (Luca Moretti) — finance approval for pilot spend

Open clarification items for the security intake we need from you (so we can scope the questionnaire and kickoff):
1) Confirm the list of systems in scope (in particular whether QA/staging-only is acceptable for pilot).
2) Any existing vendor questionnaire you prefer we complete (or we’ll use our standard security questionnaire).
3) Timeline expectations for procurement (PO or purchase order timing) and whether a short SOW is needed before PO.
4) Preferred date/time window for a 45-min security kickoff with technical stakeholders and procurement present.

Next steps I propose (action items):
- I’ll send our completed vendor questionnaire + MSA template for your review (Rishi is copied for contracting questions).
- Elena/Jacob: if you can drop the network diagram and any existing vendor questionnaire, we’ll pre-populate answers and flag gaps.
- Tentative security kickoff: Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:45 CET — please confirm or propose alternatives.

Attachments we’ll need from your side: network diagram (high-level), any prior vendor security questionnaires, and the expected procurement contact/email for PO routing.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the questionnaire and a single-slide scope summary.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com | +44 20 7946 0123

--
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference for production
From: Elena Rossi <elena@finteq.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Jacob Myers <j.myers@finteq.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: Finteq stakeholder map, procurement path, and security kickoff

Thanks Neha — useful summary. A few clarifications and I’ve attached the initial artifacts.

Confirmations:  
- Security owner: yes, I’ll own the technical review and evidence collection.
- Econ buyer: Luca Moretti (CFO) — he’ll give final signoff for any >€20k commitments; for pilot under €10k it’s direct with procurement.
- Procurement contact: Sophie Park (sophie.park@finteq.com) — she handles PO and contract intake.

What I attached:  
- finteq-network-diagram.png (high-level network + VPC boundary)
- finteq-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf (vendor questionnaire our security team uses)

Answers to your open items:  
1) Systems in scope for pilot: staging inference cluster (GCP eu-west1), staging DB snapshots (Postgres read-only), and S3 archive buckets. Production is out of scope for pilot.
2) Please complete our attached questionnaire; we expect a filled PDF back or a shared doc with answers.
3) Procurement timeline: SOP is 2–3 weeks for PO once commercial terms are agreed; if you need faster, flag it and Sophie can triage.
4) Kickoff: Wed 25 Nov 10:00 CET works for Jacob and me — Sophie should be invited for procurement items.

One more request: can you include high-level retention, data residency, and logs/audit evidence locations in the questionnaire? We need to map to our compliance runbook.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Security, Finteq
elena@finteq.com

Subject: Re: Post-discovery: Finteq stakeholder map, procurement path, and security kickoff

Thanks — quick commercial/contract note from my side.

- I’m attaching our standard MSA draft (redwood-ms-v1.docx) for Sophie to review; it’s typical SaaS terms with an addendum for inference-specific data handling.
- If Finteq requires redlines, please send Sophie’s preferred template or markups in Word — we can turn around 3–4 business days for pilot-sized agreements.
- For the pilot, confirm whether a short SOW + PO is preferable vs. a PO referencing the MSA. Both are fine; SOW helps scope data controls tightly.

Proposed procurement timeline (assuming no major legal changes):  
- Week 0: finalize SOW and pilot definition (scope, duration, acceptance criteria)
- Week 1: procurement review and PO creation
- Week 2: PO approval and kick-off environment provisioning

Marissa — could you own putting together the one-page SOW draft (scope + acceptance criteria + contacts) and share back to this thread?

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Commercial Operations
redwood-internal

Appreciate the quick replies and the attachments, Elena. Next steps and proposed kickoff agenda below — copying Sophie to bring procurement into the loop.

Proposed kickoff meeting — Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:45 CET (calendar invite to follow)
Agenda (45 min):
- 5m: Introductions and success criteria (Neha)
- 10m: Technical scope and systems in scope (Elena & Jacob)
- 15m: Questionnaire review and evidence list (walk through the PDF answers)
- 10m: Procurement & contracting path (Sophie + Rishi)
- 5m: Next steps and timelines (confirm SOW owner and PO target dates)

Action items assigned:  
- Marissa: one-page SOW draft by Mon EOD (Marissa owns)
- Elena/Jacob: confirm if any additional systems beyond the attached diagram by Mon EOD
- Sophie: confirm procurement routing and whether an internal PO template is required
- Rishi: attach MSA to Sophie and advise redline turnaround time

I’ll also populate the questionnaire with our answers and return as a first pass before the kickoff — should save time.

Thanks all — looking forward to the kickoff.
